question.text: Yashasvi Fund (Cat II): INR 100 crore NAV at start of FY. Management Fee 2% on NAV = INR 2 crore (pre-GST). Trusteeship INR 4 lakh, Fund Administrator INR 20 lakh, Custodian INR 25 lakh, Auditor INR 10 lakh, Legal INR 12 lakh. All attract GST @ 18%. What is the TOTAL GST outflow for the fund that year?

explanation.text: The Logic: Total services = INR 200 lakh (mgmt) + 4 + 20 + 25 + 10 + 12 = INR 271 lakh. GST @ 18% = INR 271 x 0.18 = INR 48.78 lakh. (The chapter's Example 6.6 uses the same template for a much larger fund.) The Trap: A is 18% on management fee only; C overshoots; D applies 9%. Cross-Exam Context: Chapter 6 Example 6.6 identical template. XIX-C and XIX-A test similar GST roll-ups. Manager's Pro-Tip: Tabulate all 18%-GST-bearing services in a single LP quarterly disclosure line. This becomes ~40-80 bps of fund NAV, non-recoverable as ITC, hitting net LP returns.
